svg.title: Bawa web wallet components and data flow (apps/web/src/app/app.tsx)
svg.desc: Screens and WalletContext coordinate the wallet lifecycle. The dashed secret boundary encloses the transient mnemonic closure in apps/web/src/wallet/vault.ts, Core operations, and local send signing. Public addresses and balance results flow through read-only apps/web/src/wallet/providers.ts and adapters. Missing adapters report no-adapter; broadcasting is disabled.

div.span: Public data — apps/web/src/wallet/providers.ts
Wallet layer — apps/web/src/wallet/core.ts
State — apps/web/src/state/wallet-context.tsx
Screens — apps/web/src/screens/

Secret trust boundary: vault closure + Core
apps/web/src/wallet/vault.ts + apps/web/src/wallet/core.ts

UI actions / public state
apps/web/src/state/wallet-context.tsx

Vault lifecycle commands / auto-lock
apps/web/src/state/wallet-context.tsx

Generated / transiently decrypted mnemonic
apps/web/src/wallet/vault.ts

Public addresses only
apps/web/src/wallet/core.ts

Real vault keys; local use only
apps/web/src/wallet/vault.ts

refreshBalances(): public addresses only
apps/web/src/state/wallet-context.tsx

Public balances or unavailable
apps/web/src/wallet/providers.ts

When registered: read-only queries / results
apps/web/src/wallet/providers.ts

apps/web/src/wallet/providers.ts
Read-only BalanceProvider registry
Until an adapter registers: balances unavailable
Reason: no-adapter
No fabricated balances

apps/web/src/wallet/adapters/btc.ts — Electrum-WS/proxy
apps/web/src/wallet/adapters/eth.ts — viem
apps/web/src/wallet/adapters/trx.ts — TronGrid
apps/web/src/wallet/adapters/ton.ts — TonCenter
Read-only BalanceProvider per chain

apps/web/src/wallet/chains.ts
ChainId: btc | eth | trx | ton only
Capabilities: derive, restore, receive, balance, history,
fee-quote, unsigned-plan, local-sign, post-sign-verify
Each: verified / blocked / unsupported / candidate, with evidence
TON fee-quote and post-sign-verify: blocked

apps/web/src/wallet/vault.ts
PBKDF2: 600,000 iterations, SHA-256; AES-GCM-256
localStorage key: bawa-vault
Envelope only: version, KDF params, salt, IV, ciphertext
Never stores mnemonic, seed, key or password
Decrypted mnemonic: transient module closure, only while unlocked
Never in React state, refs, localStorage or logs

apps/web/src/wallet/core.ts
loaded via apps/web/src/engine/boundary.ts
Trust Wallet Core 4.9.3 WASM
Generates 24-word BIP-39 mnemonic; empty passphrase
Derives addresses with default paths:
BTC m/84'/0'/0'/0/0
ETH m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
TRX m/44'/195'/0'/0/0
TON m/44'/607'/0' — one address

apps/web/src/wallet/send.ts
Offline transaction construction and local signing
Uses real vault keys
broadcastSigned returns { status: 'disabled' }
No broadcast path

apps/web/src/state/wallet-context.tsx
WalletContext provider
VaultState: no-vault / locked / unlocked
auto-lock: inactivity and page-hide
selectedChain defaults to btc
refreshBalances(): public balances

apps/web/src/app/app.tsx
react-router; lazy-loaded screen routes

apps/web/src/screens/
welcome; dashboard (index); create-wallet; import-wallet
mnemonic-backup; asset-list; asset-detail (assets/:chain)
receive; send; transaction-history; transaction-detail
network-selection; wallet-management; security-settings; lock
UI: apps/web/src/ui/ — vendored token-ui
